Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the subject of the query. The user asked for the birthday of "Prince Napoléon Bonaparte's father." The most prominent historical figure explicitly holding the title "Prince Napoléon Bonaparte" is Napoléon Eugène Louis Jean Joseph Bonaparte (the Prince Imperial), the son of Napoleon III. The Planner erroneously assumed the user was referring to Napoleon I (who was never titled "Prince Napoléon" in the specific sense of the title "Prince Napoléon" used for his grandson, though he was Prince of Italy etc., the specific title "Prince Napoléon" usually refers to the later figure). By assuming the subject was Napoleon I, the Planner directed the search toward Carlo Buonaparte (Napoleon I's father). The correct subject is the Prince Imperial, whose father is Napoleon III (born April 20, 1808), not Carlo Buonaparte (born March 29, 1746). The final answer provided by the Planner (March 29, 1746) is incorrect based on the standard historical identification of "Prince Napoléon Bonaparte."
